legal_entity: Uweb3 Management BR (operator per the Terms and Conditions, Brazil); not restated on the affiliate page.
application_conditions: 'No cost to join'; targets creators, communities and publishers reaching audiences in crypto, media buying, freelancing, e-commerce or travel; apply through the contact channels describing the audience and promotion plan; resellers/integrators directed to the partners page.
paid_action: A 'reward' when a referred person signs up and uses Kripicard; 'Earn as referrals stay active' (mechanism not explained).

commission.model_note: No amount, percentage or base published on the affiliate page. A separate 'Referral Program — Custom Fees' and an Ambassador programme are linked from the FAQ but were not read.

rules_note: Affiliates must avoid 'exaggerated claims, no promises of bypassing laws or platform policies' and disclose the affiliate relationship where required. Referrals open to users worldwide. Nobody contacted, no application made.
allowed_countries_note: 'Referrals are open to users worldwide' per the page; the card itself publishes no country list.

evidence.title: Kripicard Affiliate Program — Earn by Referring Crypto Cards (last updated June 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Free to join; unique tracked referral links; reward on sign-up and use, recurring 'as referrals stay active'; no commission figure, payout asset, threshold or frequency; apply via contact channels; no exaggerated claims or law-bypassing promises; disclose the relationship.

notes: Commission terms are not public; the programme cannot be scored until the referral ('Custom Fees') and ambassador pages, or an application reply, state them. Editorial caution: the product markets 'no-KYC' and the affiliate rules forbid promising to bypass laws — any promotion must stick to what the provider states.
